enemies.name: chomper
enemies.description: Melee. Chases the player and deals 1 contact damage. No ranged attack. Worth 100 points.

enemies.name: smice
enemies.description: Ranged. Drifts slowly left across the screen. Every 1.8 s it winds up for 0.35 s, then fires 1 projectile aimed at the player (damage 1, speed 220, radius 7, lives 8 s). 1 contact damage. Worth 150 points.

enemies.name: pigice
enemies.description: Area caster. Moves left then stops at x=200. Every 4 s places a stationary temporary zone at the nearest player position. Warns for 1.5 s before damage, then stays active for 2 s. At most two zones per caster and three globally; zones expire naturally and disappear immediately when the caster dies. 1 contact damage, worth 250 points.

enemies.name: theice
enemies.description: Boss. Giant stationary ice monster occupying the right side. Every 3.6 s fires two fans of eight balls from its upper and lower body toward the left. 200 HP, 2 contact damage, worth 2500 points. Every 8 s it also fires a beam across the whole screen at its height (1.3 s warning, then 1.8 s, 2 damage).

enemies.name: wrapped
enemies.description: Melee. Chases the player and deals 1 contact damage. No ranged attack. Worth 150 points.

enemies.name: jellybean
enemies.description: Ranged. Drifts slowly left. Every 1.4 s it winds up for 0.35 s, then fires 1 projectile aimed at the player (damage 1, speed 260, radius 8, lives 8 s). 1 contact damage. Worth 225 points.

enemies.name: gummyworm
enemies.description: Area caster. Moves left then stops at x=200. Every 5 s places a stationary temporary zone at the nearest player position. Warns for 1.5 s before damage, then stays active for 2 s. At most two zones per caster and three globally; zones expire naturally and disappear immediately when the caster dies. 1 contact damage, worth 375 points.

enemies.name: candybear
enemies.description: Boss. Giant bear planted on the candy ground. Every 2.6 s fires nine aimed fists over a 100-degree fan. 250 HP, 2 contact damage, worth 4000 points.

enemies.name: psyring
enemies.description: Melee. Chases the player and deals 2 contact damage. No ranged attack. Worth 225 points.

enemies.name: evilmask
enemies.description: Ranged. Drifts slowly left. Every 1.1 s it winds up for 0.35 s, then fires 1 projectile aimed at the player (damage 2, speed 300, radius 9, lives 8 s). 2 contact damage. Worth 325 points.

enemies.name: denturesk
enemies.description: Area caster. Moves left then stops at x=200. Every 6 s places a stationary temporary zone at the nearest player position. Warns for 1.5 s before damage, then stays active for 2 s. At most two zones per caster and three globally; zones expire naturally and disappear immediately when the caster dies. 2 contact damage, worth 550 points.

enemies.name: carry
enemies.description: Boss. Small fast tooth patrolling vertically around y=360 at up to 440 px/s, about one round trip every 3.6 s. Fires four leftward projectiles every 0.9 s over a 24-degree fan. 500 HP, 2 contact and projectile damage, worth 10000 points.
